general.title: Nova Versandkosten
general.description: Import tariffs, check shipping prices, fetch energy surcharges

tariffs.none: No tariff file imported yet. Without tariffs Shopware calculates as before.
tariffs.invalid: The stored tariff file is invalid – please import again.
tariffs.importHelp: Choose a JSON or CSV file or paste its content. “Check” shows errors without saving; “Import” replaces the current tariff file for all sales channels. Format: see README.
tariffs.paste: Content of the tariff file (JSON or CSV)
tariffs.empty: Please choose a file or paste the content.
tariffs.checked: File is valid: {name} ({products} products). Not saved yet.

check.title: Price check
check.help: Fixed prices in the home country against the current purchase price (incl. energy surcharge, peak during the period) for typical parcels. Red = net sale below purchase.

order.title: Shipping costs
order.dimsMissing: Dimensions/weight missing for at least one item – calculated by shipping category (default values).
order.beipackTo: ADD-ON to order {number} – ship together with it.

request.title: Shipping costs on request
request.open: The customer chose “shipping costs on request”. The order was placed with 0.00 shipping; payment is open.
request.label: Shipping costs ({currency}, gross or tax-free like the order)
request.notify: Notify customer by e-mail (total + payment link)
request.apply: Apply shipping costs and notify customer
request.mailFailed: E-mail could not be sent (check the mail template).

energy.title: Energy surcharges
energy.help: Fetched automatically every day (scheduled task “nova_versandkosten.energy_fetch”). In “automatic” mode (settings per sales channel) the value valid on the day applies; on errors the last value stays and a notification is created. The manual value only applies in “manual” mode or until the first fetch.
energy.effective: Effective (key = carrier in the tariff file)
energy.fetchedWithErrors: Fetch partly failed – last values stay valid.

general.title: Tours
general.description: Own delivery tours: routes, tour dates, tour deliveries, notification
general.noPostcodes: Postcode coordinates are missing. Please update or re-activate the plugin.

dates.help: A date starts open: customers along all variants of the route can book. The first booking fixes the variant (the one with the smallest deviation for that customer); afterwards only customers along this variant. You can fix or change the variant here at any time.
dates.name: Name (optional)
dates.deadlineHelp: Last order day (inclusive). Empty = default from the settings.
dates.trailerHelp: with trailer (no freight goods without trailer)
dates.ownHelp: One-off trip: enter waypoints in driving order (at least two).
dates.confirmDelete: Delete this tour date? Orders keep their data.

routes.help: Routes are templates for regular trips. Each route has one or more variants (ways) with waypoints in driving order. A customer's deviation = straight-line distance of the postcode to the waypoint line × detour factor.
routes.name: Name
routes.activeHelp: active (for hints on “shipping costs on request”)
routes.waypointsHelp: Waypoints in driving order – start, places on the way, destination. Enter postcode or place.
routes.confirmDelete: Delete this route with all variants? Tour dates remain but lose the route.

deliveries.title: Tour deliveries
deliveries.help: Order along the route (km from start) – load the deliveries reached last first.
deliveries.outOfRange: outside the price range with the current variant
deliveries.none: No orders for this date yet.

notify.title: Subscribers along the route
notify.help: For an open date all variants count. Reach: with trailer up to the largest freight tier, otherwise up to the small-parts limit. The e-mail only names the date and postcode area, never the route. Each subscriber gets at most one e-mail per date.

subscribers.title: Tour notification: subscribers
subscribers.disabled: The tour notification is switched off in the plugin settings.

order.tour: Delivery with our own tour on {date}

cms.title: Heading (optional)
cms.defaultText: We regularly deliver with our own tour. Leave your e-mail and postcode and we will let you know when a tour comes near you.
cms.hint: Form with double opt-in and captcha. Only shown when the tour notification is switched on in the plugin settings.
